The search results explicitly stated that "John II of Baden's paternal grandfather was Jacob, Margrave of Baden-Baden." However, the search results also clearly indicated that Jacob I was the *father* of John II, and Bernard I was the *father* of Jacob I (making Bernard I the paternal grandfather). By accepting the AI-generated summary ("John II of Baden's paternal grandfather was Jacob...") as a fact without verifying the actual genealogical relationships shown in the snippets (which list Jacob as the Father and Bernard as the Grandfather in other results), the agent incorrectly identified Jacob I as the grandfather instead of Bernard I. This error propagated through the conversation, leading to the wrong final answer.
